notes:
Nashu is named as the giver by the header and by the description ('Head to Yorcia Weald with Nashu') but never appears in the walkthrough, whose first line is a zone-in cutscene. I kept the header's Nashu as start rather than blanking it: he resolves, v1 already marks him in Eastern Adoulin, and the walkthrough offers no competing giver -- but the disagreement is flagged because bullet 1 reads like the real opener.

The three Ergon Loci of bullet 3 are explicitly 'in any order', so they share a group and all draw at once. Their TARGET name is the hard call: the page says 'Visit the following Ergon Locus' and then labels each by place ('Sih Gates: Lake of Light'), and the sibling Survey pages in the cache write the same entity as 'Ergon Locus: Lake of Light (Sih Gates, K-7)'. Read as a player, 'Ergon Locus' is the thing you click and 'Lake of Light' is which one -- so the locus name is recorded as the target and the place-label lives in the note. That name is not unique inside a zone (Sih Gates holds a second locus, Prominence of the Gales), hence generic_npc_name; the grid is what actually separates them.

All three loci are in different zones, so each keeps its own zone, which is right for a group. The sub-bullets under bullet 3 are travel advice and stay as notes. Bullet 4's sub-bullets are the same. Nothing in this quest is observable except the Sturdy hide pouch from the footprints; the 500 EXP and 1,000 Bayld are rewards.

notes:
Bullet 2 names its five targets as a RANGE -- 'the five cardians (2 to 6 of Diamonds)' -- not as five names, so expanding it is the one liberty taken here. I did not invent the forms: the cached Abyssea - Tahrongi zone page lists 'Two of Diamonds (A)' through 'Six of Diamonds (A)' as NPC rows, and that wiki '(A)' form is what the normaliser expects. Five markable NPCs beats one unnamed rung, but the expansion is flagged and the quest sits at medium for it.

They have no grids anywhere -- the page says only that two guard the main camp at its two exits and one sits at each of Conflux #03, #05 and #07, and the zone page leaves their positions blank. The page never says to visit them in order, so they share a group and all five draw at once.

Bullet 3 is not a step: it is advice on how to spot a glitched response (a single wrong word, or hollow stars). Bullet 4 is the hand-in. The trailing 'Zoning is required to repeat this quest' and bullet 1's sub-bullet are the same fact from two directions -- zoning wipes your progress, so the whole circuit has to happen in one visit -- and neither is a step. The Viridian abyssite of guerdon is a first-completion REWARD, so it is not evidence for anything.

notes:
Bullet 6 is four steps, not one: it is a whole dungeon run written as a route. The travel into Phomiuna Aqueducts, the locked Iron Gate on map 2, the ??? behind the bookcase on map 3 and the Ornate Gate in the hidden hallway are each something you do, and only the first two sub-bullets are pure navigation.

The Iron Gate is a genuine OR: a Bronze Key, or a Thief picking the lock with Thief's Tools -- and the page warns it usually takes more than one set. Both branches are expressible, so items_alt carries the tools rather than items_partial being set; the job half of the thief branch is only a note.

The Walnut Door in bullet 1 is scenery telling you where Despachiaire stands, not a thing you click for the quest, so it stays in the note -- Despachiaire is the target. Bullet 4's source is deliberately half-recorded: 'the Orcs' is a family and not a name, so only Tavnazian Sheep goes in mobs, and because the drop spans Lufaise Meadows and Misareaux Coast the step carries no zone at all rather than picking one.

The header's Item Reqs (Tavnazian Liver) is not a gate on starting the quest -- bullet 4 is where you go and get it -- so it sits on the trade at step 5 and as step 4's evidence, not on step 1 the way v1 has it. 'Completed Ancient Vows' comes from Quest Reqs rather than the empty Previous field; it is recorded in prev and flagged. There is exactly one observable in this quest.

notes:
A clean seven-rung ladder with three evidence points, and one avoidable loss. Bullet 1's [KI] Magian Mooglehood missive would be perfect evidence for step 1, but the resolver rejects it -- the name is not unique in res/key_items.lua, and it refuses to guess an id rather than hand back a silently wrong one. So step 1 has no evidence and the ladder first anchors on the Tandem Necklace +4 at step 2.

Both moogle steps fold to the same key: the page distinguishes 'the Magian Moogle' from 'the Magian Moogle (Blue)', but the colour is a wiki disambiguator and the normaliser drops the parenthetical, so steps 2, 3 and 5 all point at 'magian moogle' at Ru'Lude Gardens (H-5). They are still kept apart because the trades carry different requirements and the talk does not.

Step 4 keeps the necklace in items on purpose: a Magian trade hands the item back with the trial attached, so you are still holding -- and wearing -- it while your Fellow works. The 30 weapon skills themselves are invisible to the addon, and the page names no monster (only 'any Undead type monster that give XP'), so mobs stays empty rather than inventing skeletons from the after-section's location tip. That after-section is 'Notes' and contributes nothing but that tip.

Quest Reqs has two halves: 'Job Level 75 or higher' is any job, so it is level 75 with jobs left empty, and 'Adventuring Fellow level 86 or higher' has no slot and nothing observable behind it. The header's [KI] Magian trial log is a real precondition you do not acquire here, so it rides on step 1.

Moved out of the player-facing step notes (build vocabulary; see AUTHORING.md, 'Two notes, two audiences'):
  step 1: that key item name is not unique and the resolver returns no id for it

notes:
Ten bullets and almost all of them are real. The one place the ladder loses something is Purgonorgo Isle: it is not a zone in res/zones.lua at all -- the isle is part of the Bibiki Bay zone (4), with the Manaclipper ferry as its own zone in between -- so the boat steps are recorded in Bibiki Bay and the isle stays in the notes. The (F-9) on those steps is the isle's map grid, not the mainland's, which is worth a human's eye.

Bullets 7 and 8 are one action (go to the boat, click it), and bullet 8 then holds two: the click that spawns Rohemolipaud and the fight itself. So 7+8 merge and 8 splits. The fight step is honest about not being a kill -- he uses Camouflage and simply leaves -- but he is still a live target the marker can sit on. Then bullet 9 clicks the SAME boat again, which is why the fight has to stay between them: the page really does put it there.

Bullet 9's Deluxe Carbine is handed to you before the final turn-in and would have been ideal evidence for that step, but it is in the header's Reward list, so hard rule 7 applies and it is left out. That is the one deliberate loss here and it is flagged.

The Trunk gets (I-11) from bullet 3's island rather than from bullet 4, which gives no grid of its own -- read as a player, the trunk is on the island the portals just delivered you to. Quest Reqs adds Promathia Mission 2-5 on top of the Previous field's Chasing Dreams; both are in prev, and the mission one is flagged since it did not come from Previous. Fame 'r' resolves to the rabao_selbina region.

ADVERSARY: the quest is demoted to medium and steps 8 and 9 with it. Steps 7, 8 and 9 all sit at 'Bibiki Bay' (F-9), but that (F-9) is read off the Purgonorgo Isle map, which is a different grid sheet from the Bibiki Bay mainland the zone id points at -- so all three carry the same risk of drawing a marker in the wrong half of the zone, not just step 7. The grids are kept because they are what the page says and they are right for the isle, but a human should place these three.

notes:
Four bullets, two of which are steps. Bullet 2 -- 'This will unlock a new Records of Eminence category' -- is an OUTCOME of bullet 1, not something you do; a verb-scanner would have made a step out of 'unlock'. The un-numbered line above bullet 1 is a third gate on top of the header's: the First Step Forward RoE objective must already be done.

Everything between the two Jourdenaux visits is one rung because none of it is visible to the addon. Catching 60 distinct fish and clearing every Fishing (Tenacity) objective are both RoE state, and no packet reports RoE progress -- so that middle step can be drawn but never ticked. The quest is medium for exactly that: the ladder is right, the gate is unmodellable.

The rod is in items on all three steps for different reasons: bullet 1 says he only flags the quest 'while in possession of' it, the Tenacity objectives must be done with that rod and no other, and bullet 4 trades it away. Katsunaga is the fish-type counter and is advice, not a target -- talking to him is no part of the quest. Lu Shang's Fishing Rod +1 is the reward.

  step 2: Both halves are Records of Eminence state, so this rung can be drawn but never ticked off.

notes:
Three bullets, three steps, one observable -- the simplest quest in this batch and there is nothing hidden in it.

The header gives Cornelia (A) no grid; bullet 1 does, at (G-12) near Conflux #4, so start takes its grid from the walkthrough. The un-numbered line above bullet 1 is the usual Abyssea precondition (zone after Getting Lucky) and is not a step.

Bullet 2 is an obtain with two sources, and only one of them has a place: the Faunus Wyvern near Conflux #3, or the Auction House. An AH purchase has no zone, no entity and no rung, so items_partial marks the branch that could not be expressed at all rather than pretending the wyvern is the only way. The Pursuer's Wing is the evidence there and the requirement on the trade after it; the header's Item Reqs is the same wing, so it does NOT belong on step 1 -- you have not got it yet when you accept.

The closing note is a repeat loop, not steps: warp to Conflux #3 for the wing, #4 to accept and hand in, #0 to re-zone, because each drop needs a zone in between. The Cruor and the chance at an Empyrean +1 body seal are rewards.
